title: A run wait that has already reported a run's settled record still holds that run against compaction while it follows other records
outcome: Once a run wait's follow-up resume has named a run's record, that run is no longer held out of compaction and index retention by the wait, while the wait keeps following its other runs' records
acceptance: A run wait that has already reported a run's settled record still holds that run against compaction while it follows other records is done
